svg.title: AskSafe Home Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing AskSafe Home on Vercel with Next.js, deterministic safety rules, bounded Amazon Bedrock assistance, DynamoDB persistence, Terraform delivery, GitHub Actions, IAM, AWS Budgets, and FinOps guardrails.

g.text: Shippable safety decision workflow on Vercel, DynamoDB, Bedrock, Terraform, and FinOps guardrails
large text, one task at a time
GitHub Actions runs Terraform. CloudFormation bootstraps state/OIDC.
Smoke checks verify Vercel APIs, DynamoDB, Bedrock, and quota guardrails.
